description: The positive and negative NNF translations \(N^+(F),N^-(F)\) are simultaneous structural recursions on shared propositional formulas. Negation exchanges polarities, conjunction and disjunction obey De Morgan duality, and implication translates to \(N^-(F)\vee N^+(G)\) positively and \(N^+(F)\wedge N^-(G)\) negatively.
